PH2_evaluation: Apply frozen seven-class networks to all 200 externally acquired images. Use the unmodified MEL probability for binary ROC and the seven-class argmax for melanoma sensitivity; common and atypical nevi are negatives. Threshold tradeoffs use only C development calibration labels. No PH2 fitting.
PH2_source: Original PH2 images and diagnosis table from a public mirror, matched to original documentation and counts; no redistribution of images.
